analogy.rationale: Cell cycle inhibitors block proliferation and converge on mitotic arrest and DNA replication stress programs, so CDK, CDC, Aurora, and PLK inhibitors should share highly similar transcriptional responses; microtubule inhibitors also cause mitotic arrest but through a distinct cytoskeletal mechanism.
